name: anet-paid-demo
summary: anet official public agent: paid digest, an a2a-x402 payment demo

capabilities.name: Paid digest (payment demo)
capabilities.description: The same computation as text.digest, for a price, to try an a2a-x402 payment end to end: payment-required, payment-submitted, payment-completed, with the hub's signed receipt. The result is byte-for-byte the result text.digest gives for the same arguments, so what was paid for can be checked. Arguments as text.digest, up to 4 KiB.
